pages.title: Main Page
pages.body: Welcome to **Ashfall**, a city rebuilt on cinders. Start with [[Mira]], [[Theo]], or [[The Lantern Guild]].

pages.title: Mira
pages.body:
---
aliases: [Mi]
---

Mira is an archivist who grew up with [[Theo]] in [[Ashfall|the old city]].

## Early life

She learned to read from [[The Archivist]]'s ledgers.

## Relationships

- [[Theo]]: childhood friend
- [[Corin Vale]]: rival

pages.title: Theo
pages.body:
---
aliases: [The Archivist, Teddy]
---

Theo keeps the ledgers. He trusts [[Mira]] and distrusts [[The Lantern Guild]].

## Early life

Raised in the [[Ember Quarter]].
